title: Sebastian A. J. Lortz
text:
I am currently pursuing a PhD in psychometrics, backed by a foundation in statistics, psychology and health sciences. In my roles at the university, I actively contribute to research, employ advanced statistical methodologies, and foster collaborative learning environments.
My diverse academic and non-academic experience provide a comprehensive perspective, shaping my personal skills. I excel in varied environments, enhancing my collaborative potential in diverse teams and bringing adaptability and effective communication to projects.
Open to professional connections, I actively seek collaborations in the academic and research communities!



My research interests is broad and centers around - Item Response Theory and Response Time Modeling - Computerized Adaptive Testing - Application of statistical (learning) methods

title: Teaching
text:
Bachelor Supervision, Pedagogical Sciences, University of Groningen, Groningen
Supervised a group of Bachelor students on parametric and nonparametric Item Response Theory (IRT) analyses, guiding their methodological choices, data analyses, and interpretation of results.
Statistics and Research Consultancy, The Methodology Shop, University of Groningen, Groningen
Delivered targeted statistical consultation and methodological guidance to (Ph.D.) students and staff during focused 15–30-minute sessions. Covered a wide range of projects, including Bachelor/Master theses, Ph.D. dissertations, (inter)national research projects, and proposals for theses and doctoral studies.
Statistics Tutor, University of Groningen, Groningen
Provided individualized tutoring to enhance students’ comprehension and application of statistical analyses, along with tailored methodological consulting for thesis projects.
German Teacher, Tobian Language School
Instructed healthcare employees in German language skills, emphasizing practical and cross-cultural communication.

title: Teaching
text:

title: Education
text:
Skills

Statistical Modelling:
- Latent Variable Methods: (Non-)parametric Item Response Theory, Mokken Scaling, Response Time Models, Structural Equation Modelling.
- Supervised Methods: Regression Models (Generalized, Penalized, Spatial, Splines, GAM), Regression Trees (bagging, random forest, boosting, BART), Network Analysis.
- Unsupervised Methods: K-means, Hierarchical Clustering, Principal Components. - Time-Series & Other Analyses: (Non-linear) Time-Series Models, Cross-Recurrence Quantification Analysis, Detrended Fluctuation Analysis.
Algorithms: Markov Chain Monte Carlo, Gibbs Sampling, Simulated Annealing, Particle Swarm Optimization, Hill Climbing.

Languages: English (C1–C2), German (Native), Dutch (A2/B1).
Software: R (advanced), GitHub, SPSS, JASP, Microsoft Office.
